messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first verify your identity, and then we'll get everything set up. What's your date of birth?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982. So can we get all three of us switched over today?
AGENT: Thanks. Let me verify your information and pull up your family's prescriptions. Great, Kevin, you're verified. I found the Gahanna store at 85 Mill Street. Before I move everyone's prescriptions, I need the full names and dates of birth for the other two family members so I can pull up their records and move theirs as well. Who are they?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, find_stores]
CALLER: Sure. Maya Brooks, DOB June 20th, 2017. Eli Brooks, DOB February 11th, 2010. So we're all set to switch over today, right?
AGENT: Perfect. Let me pull up Maya and Eli's records and their prescriptions so we can move everything to Gahanna. Good news—all three of you are verified. Here's what I found: you have lisinopril with three refills, Maya has an albuterol inhaler with two refills, and Eli has a filled Vyvanse with no refills remaining. Let me set Gahanna as your home pharmacy and transfer the prescriptions. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already filled, so that one needs special handling—I'll flag our pharmacist to coordinate the transfer with you. Perfect! All set. Your lisinopril and Maya's albuterol are now moved to the Gahanna store at 85 Mill Street, and all three of you are switched to that as your home pharmacy. For Eli's Vyvanse, our pharmacist will reach out to coordinate the transfer of that controlled medication—that's standard procedure. You're all good to go!  [system actions: verify_identity, verify_identity, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions, list_prescriptions, set_default_store, set_default_store, set_default_store, transfer_rx, transfer_rx, flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Okay, that works. So my lisinopril and Maya's inhaler are done, and someone will call me about Eli's Vyvanse - do you know when that'll be, roughly?
AGENT: The pharmacist will reach out to you, but I don't have a specific timeframe—it depends on their schedule. They'll call to coordinate the transfer of Eli's Vyvanse. Is there anything else I can help with today?
CALLER: Okay, no specific window, got it. Can you at least make sure it's soon, not weeks out? Eli needs that refill.
AGENT (LATEST): I understand—Eli needs that medication. I flagged it as routine, but let me bump that up to same-day priority so the pharmacist calls you sooner today. Done. The pharmacist will prioritize calling you today about Eli's transfer and refill. Anything else?  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent says the Vyvanse cannot be transferred
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "The prescriptions are Kevin's lisinopril, Maya's albuterol inhaler, Eli's Vyvanse"
stop_0: Agent recaps: two moved, defaults set, Vyvanse new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent says transfer will be coordinated, not impossible."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asks nothing; just confirms priority update."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of Dr. Okafor or new-Rx request."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
